question: Should this PR be narrowed and re-proven on its exact head before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept the unrelated macOS timeout change and earlier-head native proof?
rationale: The code direction is sound, but accepting proof from a superseded implementation head and retaining unrelated test behavior are merge-scope decisions that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Split and re-prove
options.body: Remove the macOS timeout change and provide exact-head simulator or device proof for six images plus an unsupported video or file.

options.title: Accept current scope
options.body: Retain the timeout change and accept the earlier native proof after confirming that later iOS commits are behaviorally equivalent.

options.title: Pause pending evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until its native proof matches the implementation head and the unrelated scope is resolved.

recommendation.title: Split and re-prove
recommendation.body: Remove the macOS timeout change and provide exact-head simulator or device proof for six images plus an unsupported video or file.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the later implementation and unrelated timeout commits and can best confirm the intended final branch scope.
